link.title: Emulation
link.description: ZennoPoster Actions for emulating user behaviors: Mouse emulation (human-like paths, speed/jitter, Left/Right/Middle clicks, double-click, wheel, drag & drop), Keyboard emulation (character-by-character input, delays, Ctrl/Alt/Shift modifiers, combinations, paste from clipboard), Page view simulation (natural scrolling, pauses and reading time, variable speed, random stops, moving focus/visibility, anti-detection behavior).
